description: RFC 0008 stage 1: the unified game-definition oracle must catch every semantic mutation of the constructors, transitions, refunds, and settlement.

equivalent: constructor does not derive all_in after an ante
roots a flop with `pending` keyed off the folded flag alone
expected.rationale: Four mutants change no reachable state at two seats. The first two are measured over every node and PINNED as standing assertions in the oracle (see the non-vacuity pins at the end of the flop sweep), so a fixture change that reaches one of those states fails the oracle instead of letting the mutant start passing for a new reason. The last two are equivalent for structural reasons the suite also pins: the two-seat profile rejects a nonzero ante (`ante_is_rejected_in_this_profile`), so no ante is ever posted here; and `GameDef` declares no folded seat, so at a root every seat is unfolded and `stack > 0` and `!folded && !all_in` denote exactly the same set. Any OTHER uncaught mutation is a coverage gap and must be closed.
